title: Tattvacintāmaṇi of Gaṅgeśa · Śabdakhaṇḍa
author: Gaṅgeśa Upādhyāya (14th century)
blurb: The founding work of Navya-Nyāya. This book on verbal testimony runs from the defence of śabda as a means of knowledge to the debate over what words denote.
source: GRETIL e-text, input by members of the SANSKNET project; it corresponds to the Bibliotheca Indica edition (no. 98), part IV vol. 1 to part IV vol. 2, p. 599 line 2, and stops partway through the Jātiśaktivāda. The page numbers of that edition are shown in the margin.
caution: This e-text has not been proof-read, and many words run together as they would in a Devanagari print.
